description: The SPECIAL-NAMES DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE clause, ISO 12.3.7.2 - DYNAMIC LENGTH [STRUCTURE] dynamic-length-structure-name-1 [IS] {[SIGNED] [SHORT] PREFIXED | DELIMITED (choice indicators) | physical-structure-name-1} - the physical layout a DYNAMIC LENGTH clause may name (13.18.19.3 SR2). A COBOL-2014 introduction, with dynamic-length elementary items (the dynamic-length-item-2014 row). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the ISO/IEC 1989:2002 SPECIAL-NAMES paragraph (§2002:12.2.6) provides a means for a closed list of things, from 'specifying currency signs and symbols' to 'relating a data item to the status of a terminal input-output operation', and its general format ends `[ CURRENCY SIGN IS literal-7 ... ] … [ DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA ] [ CURSOR IS data-name-1 ] [ CRT STATUS IS data-name-2 ] .`; §2014:12.3.6.1 adds `[ dynamic-length-structure-clause ] …`, 'where dynamic-length-structure-clause is: DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE dynamic-length-structure-name-1 IS ...', §2014:12.3.6.3 GR18 'If the PREFIXED phrase is specified in the DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE clause, data described with dynamic-length-structure-name-1 is prefixed by a length field', and §2014:E.3 states the change, its item 8: 'The addition of the DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE clause in special names, and the ability to reference that dynamic-length-structure-name in the DYNAMIC LENGTH clause provides the ability to specify the structure of that data item.' §2023:12.3.7.4 GR18 and GR19 carry the 2014 rules unchanged, so 2014 = 2023 (no VCR row: Annex E covers 2014-2023 only). LIVE (kb/Work PB829): the name is declared and inherited by contained source elements; its PREFIXED length field bounds the item's maximum size (8.5.1.10.1) and the LIMIT phrase (SR4); physical-structure-names are an implementor set WiseOwl COBOL leaves empty (12.3.7.3 SR32, COBOL2257). Parse-arm gated on recognition (VisitDynamicLengthStructureClause).
vcr: 2014 introduction with the DYNAMIC LENGTH clause it serves (§2014:E.3 item 8; dynamic-length-item-2014)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. DLS.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    DYNAMIC LENGTH STRUCTURE DLS1 IS SHORT PREFIXED.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-D PIC X DYNAMIC LENGTH DLS1 LIMIT IS 20.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE "HELLO" TO W-D.
    DISPLAY W-D.
    STOP RUN.
